Controls

Action effects
Continue after loading
Starts the game as soon as loading finishes, without waiting for a key press.
Infinite bolts
Bolts are never used up. If you have run out, a bolt appears when this is switched on.
Dot crosshair
Replaces the static crosshair with a round dot in the centre of the screen.
Pause in background
Instant inventory
Notify about major versions
Cursor speed
Cursor speed in menus and the inventory. 1.00 matches the system cursor.
The game saves itself at key moments of the story and of tasks.
You can save only next to a burning campfire - both quicksaves and saves from the menu.
How many quicksaves are kept. When all are taken, a new one replaces the oldest.
Multiplier for the number of stalker squads in the Zone. Lower - emptier and calmer, higher - more encounters and fights.
Multiplier for the number of mutants in the Zone. Lower - fewer encounters, higher - more dangerous trips.
Squads that meet far from the player fight each other in a simplified simulation: life in the Zone goes on without you.
Military helicopters appear in the Zone.
Fast travel to discovered points from the map spot menu of the PDA.
Stalkers post about events in the Zone to the common PDA channel: fights, finds, deaths of comrades.
Dead stalkers can carry money.
Removes dropped items and weapons over time, so the world does not fill up with junk and lose performance.
Without sleep the character gets tired, and the longer he stays awake, the worse he feels. Regular sleep is needed.
The flashlight, night vision, detectors and containers run on a common charge that batteries refill.
A technician does not repair and upgrade instantly: an item you hand over is ready only after a while.
The crosshair in the centre of the screen.
The crosshair spreads while moving and shooting, showing the current dispersion of the weapon.
Shows the distance to whatever the crosshair points at.
The crosshair is coloured by your relation to the target (enemy, neutral, friend); below it are the name and faction of a character, and up close the name of an item.
On-screen indicators: health, stamina, weapon and ammo.
The minimap in the corner of the screen.
With a helmet or a gas mask on, its glass is seen over the screen: cracks, raindrops, fogging.
A health bar appears over an enemy after a hit.
Bullets leave a visible glowing trail.
Picking an item up from the ground shows a message with its name.
The weapon and items in the hands. Switch it off for a clean screenshot.
Black bars at the top and bottom of the screen, as in a film.
Keeps the far background blurred, like a camera lens. Works with Depth of field switched on in the graphics settings.
Dead Air scenes for actions that have no animation of their own - repairing gear, cleaning a weapon, lighting a campfire: fade, camera sway and sound.
A short hand movement when you open a door or press a button.
The inventory opens the moment the key is pressed, without waiting for the backpack to come off. The backpack scene still plays behind the window.
Radios in camps play music.
The engine noise of helicopters is heard.
A sound and a slight camera jolt when you raise the weapon to aim and lower it.
A press toggles crouching instead of holding it while the key is down.
The game pauses when its window loses focus, for example on Alt+Tab.
Language of the game texts; takes effect after a restart. Only installed translations are listed.
Tell when a new major version of the mod is out. Updates within the current version are always checked.
Debug information on screen. Available only in developer mode.
Mod communities in the menu
Shows the icons of the mod's communities in the main menu and the pause menu. A click on an icon opens the page in the browser.
